full_details: In the morning Phillips, Cowley and Pope rehearsed the letter. The first paper Cowley showed was a tally. Pope kept the tally in his belt and put the play's letter in Cowley's hand at the door, on the third entrance. At Leadenhall the penny loaves were still shrunk on the assize-pan, and still a penny. You did not measure them, and you bought nothing. Beadles stood about watching idle silk-weavers and men in old soldiers' coats. The talk, which you did not verify, was that the Council had spoken in Star Chamber of the present scarcity and was sending justices home to keep hospitality. You wrote three sentences under Prices. A hungry man, an angry man. Hunger breaks stone walls. The loaf goes by the Mayor's weight and the belly by God's. At two you played. The plot named you as a player and named no author.
one_sentence: You rehearsed Two Gentlemen, heard the meal-market talk at Leadenhall, and wrote three proverbs under Prices before you played at two.
title: Three proverbs under Prices
